domain: granular magnetic recording media / all-optical switching
note: In granular media the term is read off the final ensemble state. Per-grain reversal probability, the bias-to-noise ratio that produces it, and the pulse count that buys the ensemble's confidence ride along.

components.name: probability that one grain reverses in one pulse
net magnetization of the grain ensemble after N pulses
helicity-selective bias (MCD) against the thermal coin flip
pulses needed for the ensemble to approach its steady state
elapsed time to a stable written state

divergences.note: The ensemble can be called 'switched' while every grain remains a coin flip. Lambert 2014 granular FePt reached 10-20% of saturation; the reptation model's steady state m_inf = (P_- - P_+)/(P_- + P_+) is a probability ratio, not a guarantee. Determinism at the ensemble level is a statistical approach with time constant ~1/(delta P), purchased with pulse count.

ensemble_alignment.unit: fraction of saturation, Lambert et al. 2014 granular FePtAgC under circular polarization

per_grain_probability.unit: probability at full demagnetization (~14 mJ/cm2 in FePt), John et al. 2017

divergences.note: Lambert's 1 kHz sweeps excited each grain ~1,000-10,000 times. 'Deterministic' reads as guaranteed, but the guarantee is a statistical confidence that costs 3-4 orders of magnitude more pulses than a single write event. The speed claim inherits the weld: the number that travels is the pulse duration, the number that decides is the pulse count.

pulse_count.unit: excitations per grain, Lambert 1 kHz sweeps

divergences.note: John et al. 2017 conclude 'single shot will never be achieved with MCD.' Read as a law, this closes the question; read as a ratio, it states that a 2% bias cannot beat a 50% coin flip in one trial. The noise floor is thermodynamic, but the bias term is optical and engineerable - IFE enhanced by microcavities or plasmonic antennas, dual-pulse ps steering (4 pulse pairs deterministic in continuous Pt/Co/Pt). The weld hides which term is the wall.

bias_to_noise_ratio.unit: MCD ratio, Ellis 2016: ~2% sufficient, ~3% matches experiment
